description: This PHP class defines EmbeddedURLForDailymotion, which extends an abstract class for handling video URLs. It provides methods to validate and generate embedded Dailymotion URLs based on input URLs, including regex patterns for matching different URL formats.

classes.name: EmbeddedURLForDailymotion
classes.description: A class that manages and validates Dailymotion video URLs for embedding purposes, extending an abstract video URL class.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Returns the embedded URL for a Dailymotion video if the URL is valid and matches specific formats; otherwise, throws an exception or returns null.
